immutabilityArchitecture.primaryKeys: Composite PK (match_id, innings, over_num) for match_over_snapshots; (match_id, innings, wicket_num) for match_dismissal_snapshots
immutabilityArchitecture.insertStrategy: Append-only insertion with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for dismissals; exact boundary upsert for overs
immutabilityArchitecture.ballEventCorrections: match_ball_events uses superseded_by and is_confirmed = false instead of row deletion
immutabilityArchitecture.runtimeProtection: Application database role has zero DELETE grants in production settlement workflows
immutabilityArchitecture.migrationSafe: DDL and migrations run under dedicated migration scripts without impacting runtime append-only logic
